about.intro: I'm an osteopath, trained in London, and a women's health practitioner, with over seven years of clinical practice. I'm not a medical doctor: my work sits alongside your medical care.

aboutText:
I'm a women's health practitioner and an osteopath. I trained in London, and I have always been fascinated by how the female body works.

But this work isn't just professional. It's personal.

For years, I struggled with acne, PMS, gut issues and painful periods. I went on the pill at a young age and spent seven years not knowing what my natural cycle even felt like. When I came off it, everything came back, but worse: the pain, the inflammation, the weight changes, the exhaustion, even though I was the most active I had ever been. After a year of struggling, with little real guidance from my gynaecologist, I accepted a coil because I could see no other option.

That is when things started to shift. I began working on my gut health, my nutrition and my inflammation, and I started actually listening to my body. Four years later I had the coil removed. It took time to readjust, but for the first time things felt different: less pain, less PMS, more energy, periods that made sense.

That experience is why The Cycle Space exists. I don't want other women to spend years feeling dismissed, confused or disconnected from their own body.

Today I look at you as a whole person, not just at your symptoms. And I still find this work fascinating.
manifestoTitle: I take the time to understand
manifestoText:
A first session lasts 90 minutes, because years of painful periods don't fit into a quarter of an hour. I listen, I ask a lot of questions and I look at the whole picture: your cycle, your digestion, your sleep, your stress, your history.

I don't diagnose and I don't prescribe treatment: that is your doctor's or gynaecologist's job. Mine is to help you understand your body and find what helps you day to day.
manifestoQuote: Once you understand what is happening in your body, it is already less frightening.
forYouTitle: You are probably in the right place if...
forYou: You have been told everything looks normal, but you know something is off.
You have PMS, PMDD, PCOS, endometriosis, painful periods, hormonal acne or irregular cycles.
You are coming off hormonal birth control — pill, IUD, implant — and want to understand your natural cycle.
You are going through perimenopause or menopause and struggling with the changes.
You are trying to understand your fertility signs.
You want to understand your body, not just be handed a protocol.
